what: PubChem Periodic Table, download of all 118 elements, 17 columns (National Center for Biotechnology Information, US National Library of Medicine). Page: https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/periodic-table/
rights: Committed: NCBI 'itself places no restrictions on the use or distribution of the data contained therein' (https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/home/about/policies/); NLM: works of the US government are not subject to copyright in the US (https://www.nlm.nih.gov/web_policies.html). The values are physical properties compiled by PubChem from named sources; NCBI notes that submitters may claim rights it cannot assess. No claim of that kind was found for this table.
